name: comp-381
title: Filter Checkbox Popover
blurb: Popover with checkbox filters and apply/clear actions.
description: A shadcn Popover with checkboxes for filter options (Real Time, Top Channels, Last Orders, Total Spent) plus Apply and Clear buttons.
use_when: Filtering data tables or lists by multiple optional criteria inline without leaving the current view.
avoid_when: With many filter options (>10) — consider a sidebar panel instead of a popover.
a11y: Checkboxes are properly labeled; buttons are accessible; popover uses separator role; full keyboard navigation.
